leadText:
(Japanese: ヤオヘイ Yaohei) is a character of the day who appeared in A Double Dilemma. He was not given a name in the English dub. He and his wife run a greengrocer store in North Petalburg. Like everyone else in North Petalburg, he is obsessed with Petalburg City Gym Leader Norman and his family.

Yaohei claims to have known and Max for all of their lives and that he is good friends with Norman. However, he confused with Norman's family.

He later got into an argument with Rose after the real May and Max showed up, over which ones were the fakes.
